releases.name: Open BIM Studio 0.1 — Preview
changes: Parametric reinforcement cages, bars, meshes and area reinforcement.
Lightweight line display for reinforcement by default. Diameter display is available through Graphics > Rebar with diameter.

Reinforcement enclosed in supported opaque slab hosts is omitted from the GPU upload. Selecting the host/reinforcement or using wireframe/section box reveals it again. Sloped, concave and unsupported layered hosts stay visible.
More compact UI with the duplicate top title row removed.
Pan/shader correction, selectable grid heads and complete mullion outlines.
Reinforcement notation, schedules and example models.
Storey isolation also hides reinforcement; disable isolation to inspect it.
Dense reinforcement annotations on the example plan can overlap and need manual layout refinement. The example sheets are demonstration drawings.
